announcements.title: Food Pantry
announcements.details: The Andrew County Food Pantry October collection is canned pumpkin. Today is the last Sunday to bring it.

announcements.title: November Breakfast
announcements.details: Our first Sunday fellowship breakfast runs from 9:45 to 10:10 a.m. before worship.

announcements.title: Next Sunday
announcements.details: Power of Healing: in Luke 8 Jesus heals and gives life.

announcements.title: Annual Meeting
announcements.details: Our annual FCC business meeting follows the worship service. Please stay for a potluck lunch after the meeting.

announcements.title: Nursing Home Worship
announcements.details: Join us to sing hymns, read Scripture and visit with residents at LaVerna at 2:00 p.m. and Abundant Acres at 3:00 p.m. All ages are welcome. Ask Brenda Barnes if you would like to help or ride along.
